name: @flyingrobots/yalikedags
description: Ya like dags? Turn a Linear project into a dependency DAG, find the frontier, the workstreams and the critical path, audit the cards, and look at it in a local viewer.

scripts.test:browser: bun run build:viewer && playwright test -c e2e/playwright.config.ts
scripts.check: bun run build:viewer && bun run lint && bun run docs:lint && bun run clean-room && bun test
scripts.test:live: bun run fixture:provision && YALIKEDAGS_LIVE=1 bun test test/live/
